name: mijnservices-wiki
description: RAG search and chat for MijnServices sources

scripts.dev: pnpm exec concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,cyan "PORT=8787 pnpm run dev:server" "sh -c 'PORT=$(node scripts/choose-port.mjs); echo Frontend: http://localhost:$PORT/; pnpm --dir frontend dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT'"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:backend
scripts.dev:frontend: sh -c 'PORT=$(node scripts/choose-port.mjs); echo Frontend: http://localhost:$PORT/; pnpm --dir frontend dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT'
